name: Pandora Behaviour Engine+
author: Monitor221hz
description: Builds Skyrim's animation behaviour files for animation mods, in place of Nemesis. Run it from the instance's Tools after adding or removing animation mods.
curator_note: Installs the self-contained build (it runs without .NET installed); the *_win-*_net.zip assets need the .NET runtime and are not this entry. Every release so far is tagged -beta, and v5.0.0-beta is the one the project calls its stable release. The archive keeps its files at the top level, so the Skyrim package places it in Data/Pandora Behaviour Engine+, where the instance's pandora tool expects it.
